assessments.quote: In this work the authors compare the accuracy of two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) implementations of a computer-aided image segmentation method to that of physician observers
assessments.reason: Compares 2D vs 3D iterative watershed segmentation of hepatic tumors and reports accuracy limitations relative to manual outlines, but does not systematically discuss technical bottlenecks or open problems.

assessments.quote: Image registration and segmentation techniques were applied to enable the visualization of the tumor and the corresponding post-RFA necrosis in the same framework.
assessments.reason: Uses segmentation of liver tumors for RFA coverage assessment; segmentation is a tool, not the studied bottleneck, and no challenges/limitations of segmentation are discussed.

assessments.quote: This research offers a computer-aided diagnosis system, which uses computed tomography scans to categorize hepatic tumors as benign or malignant.
assessments.reason: Task is benign/malignant classification of liver tumors, not segmentation; no segmentation bottlenecks discussed.

assessments.quote: In this paper, we focus on an automated computation of optimal needle insertion in computer-assisted surgery with 3D visualization.
assessments.reason: Concerns trajectory optimization for RFA needle insertion, not liver tumor segmentation or its challenges.

assessments.quote: The combination segmentectomy has a certain effect in liver tumor,but it has limitations in some tumors,especially in the tumors with massive adhesion of surrounding tissue.
assessments.reason: Proposes a combined segmentation method for liver tumor CT and explicitly notes limitations for tumors with adhesion to surrounding tissue; limited scope, no broader bottleneck analysis.

assessments.quote: Preoperative vessel segmentation in the patient's liver region has become an increasingly important and challenging problem.
assessments.reason: Focuses on hepatic vessel segmentation in liver tumor patients, not tumor segmentation itself; mentions challenges but for vessels, and only suggests extension to tumor segmentation.

assessments.quote: The objective of this research was to investigate the application value of deep learning-based computed tomography (CT) images in the diagnosis of liver tumors.
assessments.reason: Applies CNN segmentation of liver tumors for diagnosis but reports only positive performance; no technical challenges, limitations, or open problems are discussed.

assessments.quote: However, accurate identification and segmentation of hepatic blood vessels in CT images poses a formidable challenge.
assessments.reason: Addresses liver vessel segmentation, not liver tumor segmentation; the stated challenge concerns vessels, so population/task constraints are not met for tumor segmentation.

assessments.quote: In this paper, we propose a semi-automatic method for liver segmentation of 2D CT scans into three labels denoting healthy, vessel, or tumor tissue based on graph cuts.
assessments.reason: Proposes a semi-automatic graph-cut method for liver tumor segmentation but does not analyze technical bottlenecks, limitations, or open problems.

assessments.quote: Brain tumor identification and classification by the application of deep learning and sophisticated image-processing techniques have been receiving a lot of attention in the medical field.
assessments.reason: Review of brain tumor detection/classification, not liver tumor segmentation; population and task do not match.

assessments.quote: Robotic systems for computed tomography (CT)-guided needle insertion have been developed to address the limitations of conventional manual needle insertion.
assessments.reason: Review of CT-guided needle insertion robotics; unrelated to liver tumor segmentation bottlenecks.

assessments.quote: Comprehensive motion management for liver SBRT on a 1.5 T MR-Linac: Initial clinical experience and dosimetric comparison with an ITV-based workflow
assessments.reason: Concerns motion management for liver SBRT radiotherapy, not liver tumor segmentation.
